outputs.content:
I can't give you a single number, because the two current SpruceChat sources disagree:

- **10 seats** — SpruceChat Plus terms page, updated November 10, 2026 [S1](https://spruce-terms.example/pricing)
- **15 seats** — SpruceChat official help center, retrieved November 11, 2026 [S2](https://spruce-help.example/pricing)

Both were retrieved today, so this isn't an old-vs-new discrepancy; it's a live conflict between the terms page and the help center. The terms page is the more likely authoritative one for contractual seat counts, but I'd confirm with SpruceChat support before relying on either figure for a purchase or renewal decision.

**Sources**
- [S1](https://spruce-terms.example/pricing) — Spruce Terms, published 2026-11-11
- [S2](https://spruce-help.example/pricing) — Spruce Help, published 2026-11-11
